Gramlot 0.2.0 adds HTML/SVG data binding to the native foundation of 0.1.x. The DOM depends on the Source and the Data: Data changes reach the DOM, and native controls write back.

## What is new

- `dataSetter(destination_path, value=None, **attr)` writes initial Data values and replaces the legacy `data(path, value)`; the HTML5 `<data>` element is `html_data(...)`.
- Pointers `^` (follow), `=` (read once) and `==` expressions; relative, symbolic and `?attr` paths; variable datapaths.
- `dataFormula`, `dataController` and `remoteSource`. Named logic is the primary path: `class Logic` in the page companion `foo_aux.js`. Inline code runs under a permissive Content Security Policy and raises a clear error under a strict one.
- Native controls bound with `value='^path'` (text, number, range, select, temporal, color, textarea), `live`, checkbox and radio groups, `visible`, reactive `style` and `class`, bound SVG attributes, freeze and thaw.
- Buttons with a nested `dataController`, and `connect_on<event>`.
- A minimal Host contract in Python and JavaScript: `resolve_page`, `resolve_resources`, `open_page` with a mount prefix chosen by the adapter; `FileHost(pages_dir)` as reference; pages keep `Page.css` and same-name companions (`foo.css`, `foo_aux.js`).
- Browser bootstrap `PageBootstrap`: stylesheet links, companion imports and Logic checks before the page starts.
- Example families `binding` (b01-b11) and `controllers` (c01-c09, including the end-to-end story), each page in Python with its JavaScript equivalent.

## Qualification

Qualified on Chromium 153, WebKit 26.6 and Firefox 155 (report GC-215 in `docs/internal/215-qualification-0-2-0.md`): full Python and JavaScript suites in clean environments, the end-to-end story through the real Page/Host/TYTX/PageBootstrap path, the served runtime checked against a fresh build, and the acceptance pages on the verified adapters `gramlot-uvicorn`, `gramlot-js-server` (Node.js and Bun) and `gramlot-serverless`. `gramlot-django`, `gramlot-fastapi`, `gramlot-flask` and `gramlot-kajenn` are deferred to after 0.2.0.

## Upgrading from 0.1.x

- Pages without binding run unchanged: native HTML and SVG, `Page.css`, `@source` methods and `remoteSource`.
- `data(...)` on `root` now raises an error: use `dataSetter(...)` for Data values and `html_data(...)` for the HTML5 element.
- Custom hosts implement `resolve_page`/`resolvePage` and `resolve_resources`/`resolveResources`, pass the mount prefix to `open_page`, and serve the page companions.

See `docs/public/095-writing-pages.md` and `docs/public/090-classes-and-hosts.md`.

## Artifacts

`gramlot-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` and `gramlot-0.2.0.tar.gz` (also on PyPI), `gramlot-native-html-0.2.0.tgz` (`npm pack` of `js/`), and `SHA256SUMS`. The JavaScript core is published on JSR as `@genro/gramlot` 0.2.0.
